items.headline: Lucid Motors’ EV output falls to lowest level in almost 2 years
items.detail: The company is deliberately limiting production after years of struggling to find mass-market demand for its EVs.

items.headline: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
items.detail: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU to comply with the AI Act. Editing can make the invisible marks harder to detect, it says.

items.headline: Meta Muse gives AMD a boost as AI momentum shifts to personal agents
